author: Stahly
description:
Gaahleri just launched their brand-new Omni Series paint line on Kickstarter. The pitch is bold: one paint that excels as both a brush paint and an airbrush paint, thanks to what they're calling OmniShift Technology. I got my hands on a batch of prototypes ahead of launch, and here is my first impression.

The post Gaahleri’s Omni Series launched: I tested the prototypes early, and I’ve got feelings appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Gaahleri’s Omni Series launched: I tested the prototypes early, and I’ve got feelings
